name: Introduction to Data Science Foundations
description: Explores the fundamental lifecycle of data science projects, encompassing problem formulation and data collection. It establishes the basic framework for understanding how data flows from raw inputs to actionable insights.
common_pitfalls: Confusing correlation with causation during early exploratory phases.

name: Data Acquisition and Presentation
description: Focuses on gathering raw datasets from disparate sources and structuring them into standardized presentation formats. Students learn how to pitch data-driven ideas effectively using professional slides.
common_pitfalls: Failing to validate the integrity and authenticity of the ingested data sources.

name: Data Preprocessing and Cleaning
description: Addresses the essential task of handling missing values, outliers, and formatting inconsistencies in raw datasets. Proper preprocessing ensures that downstream analytical models receive clean and reliable inputs.
common_pitfalls: Over-imputing data which can introduce artificial bias into the model.

name: Exploratory Data Analysis
description: Involves using statistical graphics and summary metrics to uncover underlying structures in data. It helps data scientists formulate hypotheses and discover anomalies prior to advanced modeling.
common_pitfalls: Relying solely on summary statistics without visualizing the raw distribution.

name: Board Book Documentation and Project Governance
description: Covers the structural components of maintaining comprehensive project documentation and updated board books. It ensures transparency, accountability, and reproducibility throughout the project lifecycle.
common_pitfalls: Treating documentation as an afterthought rather than an iterative process.

name: Advanced Predictive Modeling and Evaluation
description: Focuses on training machine learning algorithms to make predictions on unseen data and rigorously evaluating their performance. Students learn to optimize hyperparameters and avoid overfitting.
prerequisites: Board Book Documentation and Project Governance
common_pitfalls: Evaluating model performance exclusively on the training dataset.
